Our gelato

Every scoop starts with Gelato by Maria, our in-house kitchen where tradition meets a modern twist. We make our gelato fresh every single day, in small batches, using locally sourced Jersey milk and the same obsession for quality that won us Gelato Parlour of the Year.

We don’t just focus on flavour, we focus on standards too. With a 5-star food hygiene rating, every batch is prepared with the care you’d expect from a fine kitchen.

  • From teat to tub, rich Jersey milk churned fresh into gelato.
  • More flavour, less fat, naturally lighter than ice cream, with all the indulgence.
  • All the creaminess, none of the guilt, fewer calories, maximum taste.
  • For everyone, vegetarian as standard, with vegan and gluten-free options.

from our kitchen to yours

The kitchen behind the scoop

The Scoop Company is Warlingham’s cherry-blossom dessert parlour, a family-friendly destination with over 140 Google reviews and a loyal following of scoopers.

Gelato by Maria is our in-house gelato kitchen. Maria trained with Italian gelato chefs whose craft dates back to 1946, then built our gelato lab from the ground up. Real gelato, made properly: less air and more product, more milk and less cream, lower sugar, served slightly warmer for a richer, creamier taste, and never deep-frozen for months.

Stock Gelato by Maria and you’re serving the exact gelato that fills our own cabinet, the one that won Gelato Parlour of the Year.

Who’s who: The Scoop Company is the parlour and parent company. Gelato by Maria is its artisan gelato arm, the kitchen this wholesale range comes from.
